name: Standup Digest
description: Reads yesterday's standup thread and posts a blockers-first summary back to the channel.

supervisor.instructions: Send the work to reader first, then hand what it found to poster. Do not call tools yourself.

specialists.name: reader
specialists.instructions: Read the standup channel and pull out who is blocked and on what.

specialists.name: poster
specialists.instructions: Write a summary under 100 words, blockers first, and post it to the channel.
